'''Tommy Bursi''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Buford tournament]] on 14 April 2001 with [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|AITC Chadra-Fans]], according to Adam Drake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2092">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-drake-wins-gq-buford-tourney-4-14-01d2092/ drake-wins-gq-buford-tourney-4-14-01], DeckTech (Adam "ADrake" Drake, 16 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-drake-wins-gq-buford-tourney-4-14-01d2092/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
